counterparties.quote: Counterparty "Oskemen Rolling Mill LLP" is a designated RESTRICTED SUBSIDIARY of the Borrower. Relationship: Wholly owned operating subsidiary within the Borrower's Restricted Group. It is a member of the Restricted Group under the Facility.

Counterparty "Altai Ore Processing LLP" is a designated UNRESTRICTED SUBSIDIARY of the Borrower. Relationship: Operating subsidiary designated as UNRESTRICTED and accordingly falling outside the collateral perimeter of the Facility. It sits outside the Restricted Group; transfers of assets to this entity fall outside the Facility's covenant and collateral scope.
